name: stuntdouble
description: Authentic user insights from autonomous AI agents, backed by evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Stunt Double gives product teams authentic user insights from autonomous AI agents, backed by evidence. Teams cast AI users, called actors, to match their own audience: each has a background, a goal, a device, a locale and a personal inbox. Given a task, an actor drives a real browser through a product, prototype or Figma design on its own, signing up, verifying its email and choosing every click itself. Every finding comes back with its evidence: the screenshot, the step and what the actor said.

From here you can:
- Read a checklist run as a card: the verdict, each check with the screenshot behind it, and what changed since the last run. The card updates while the run is still going.
- Run a checklist or automation against production, staging or a preview link.
- Plan and launch an interview with AI participants, then read the synthesized report.
- See the themes in what stakeholders said about a project, and triage the feedback.
- Check how well AI agents can find, understand and act on a website, from the public Stunt Double Index.
- Search a workspace for the projects, actors, checklists and interviews that already exist.

Built for product designers, engineers and QA leads who want to see a flow tried before real people try it.

Limits: the plugin needs a Stunt Double account and reaches only that account's workspaces. Runs take minutes and count toward your plan. Actors reach any public URL and handle email sign-in through their own inboxes; they ask a person only for what a person holds, such as a code sent to a phone. Workspaces, billing and account deletion stay in the Stunt Double dashboard.
capabilities: Read checklist runs with per-check evidence
Run checklists and automations against any public URL

positive.description: Read a checklist run as a card
positive.prompt: Show me the latest run of the Checkout checklist in my Demo Shop project and tell me what failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the run card (verdict, score, each check with the actor's evidence, changes since the previous run) and names the failing checks in one or two sentences.

positive.description: Score a public site on the Index
positive.prompt: How agent-ready is stripe.com, and where do agents get stuck?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Index card for stripe.com (score out of 100, band, rank, category scores) and lists the top frictions agents hit, with a link to the public report.

positive.description: Run a checklist and follow it
positive.prompt: Run the Checkout checklist in Demo Shop again and tell me whether it passes now.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a run, shows the run card while the actor works (it refreshes itself), and reports the verdict once the run completes.

positive.prompt: What are people saying in feedback on the Demo Shop project?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the main themes in the project's feedback comments with how many comments sit under each, and an implementation brief.

positive.description: Find existing work before creating more
positive.prompt: Do I already have anything in Stunt Double that tests checkout?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching checklist, project and actor in the review workspace by name, without creating anything.

negative.prompt: Delete my Stunt Double account and all my data.
Upgrade my Stunt Double plan and charge my card.
Show me the checklists in the Acme Corp workspace.

review.commerce_description: Stunt Double does not sell products or process payments through this plugin. Plans are managed in the Stunt Double dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First release: read checklist runs and Index reports as cards, run checklists and automations, launch AI user interviews, summarize feedback, and search a workspace.
